sections.title: Beyond kind and funny
sections.content: You already have kedves, vicces, csendes, hangos from A1. Here are four more common ones, working exactly the same way — right before the noun, or after van for a description.

items.spanish: A kollégám nagyon okos és szorgalmas.
items.english: My colleague is very smart and hardworking.

sections.content: nagyon ("very") from A1 works with every one of these — nagyon okos, nagyon türelmes — the simplest way to add emphasis without any new grammar.
